remedies_catalog.solution_title: Cow Dung & Seasoned Wood Ash Manure
remedies_catalog.instructions: Mix dried cow dung with seasoned wood ash in a 3:1 ratio. Gently dig into the soil at the base of the plant to restore nitrogen, potassium, and carbon naturally.
preparation_steps: Collect 5 kg of sun-dried cow dung and crush finely into a crumbly powder.
Add 1.5 kg of seasoned hardwood ash (from kitchen stove/chulha) in a 3:1 proportion.
Blend in 250 g of powdered dry neem leaves to repel subsurface termites and nematodes.
Moisten slightly with water or fermented rice starch water and let rest for 2 hours in shade.
remedies_catalog.dosage_schedule: Apply 1 generous handful (150g) around the root zone, 5-8 cm away from the main stem. Water lightly.
remedies_catalog.best_timing: Early morning (6:00 AM - 8:30 AM) when topsoil moisture is high.
remedies_catalog.cultural_prevention: Avoid over-irrigation. Apply rice straw mulch to stimulate indigenous earthworm activity.
remedies_catalog.seed_traits: Deep-rooting traditional cultivar, natural high tolerance to nitrogen fluctuations.

language_translations.bn: শুকনো গোবরের সাথে কাঠের ছাই ৩:১ অনুপাতে মিশিয়ে গাছের গোড়ার মাটিতে প্রয়োগ করুন। এতে প্রাকৃতিকভাবে নাইট্রোজেনের ঘাটতি দূর হবে।
language_translations.hi: सूखे गोबर में लकड़ी की राख 3:1 के अनुपात में मिलाकर पौधे की जड़ों के पास मिट्टी में डालें। इससे नाइट्रोजन और पोटाश की कमी प्राकृतिक रूप से पूरी होगी।

remedies_catalog.instructions: Crush 50g neem seeds or fresh neem leaves, boil in 1L of water with 2 drops of organic mustard soap. Cool, strain, and spray early in the morning.
preparation_steps: Crush 50 g mature neem seed kernels or 100 g freshly pounded neem leaves.
Soak overnight in 1 liter of fresh pond or tube-well water.
Filter the extract through a clean muslin cloth to remove coarse particulate.
Stir in 5 ml of pure cold-pressed mustard oil or 2 drops of mild washing soap as a natural wetting agent.
remedies_catalog.dosage_schedule: Spray thoroughly on both upper and lower leaf surfaces. Repeat after 5 days for 2 cycles.
remedies_catalog.best_timing: Early morning before 7:30 AM or evening after 5:00 PM to protect honeybees.
remedies_catalog.cultural_prevention: Plant yellow sticky traps and African marigold borders around field perimeters.
remedies_catalog.seed_traits: High glucosinolate content, naturally repels foliar pests and diamondback moth.

language_translations.bn: ৫০ গ্রাম নিম পাতা বা বীজ ১ লিটার জলে ফুটিয়ে ঠাণ্ডা করুন। সকালে পোকা আক্রান্ত পাতার নিচে স্প্রে করুন।
language_translations.hi: 50 ग्राम नीम की पत्तियों को 1 लीटर पानी में उबालकर ठंडा करें। सुबह के समय पत्तों पर स्प्रे करें।

remedies_catalog.pathogen_type: Sucking Hemiptera & Vector of Viral Mosaic
remedies_catalog.instructions: Grind 5 green chilies and 1 bulb of garlic in 500ml water. Let ferment for 24 hours, strain, and dilute with 2L water before spraying.
preparation_steps: Finely crush 10 hot bird's eye chilies and 1 whole bulb of garlic.
Infuse in 500 ml water along with a pea-sized pinch of hing (asafoetida).
Allow to steep in an earthen pot for 24 hours to ferment capsaicinoids and sulfur compounds.
Strain through double cotton filter and dilute with 2.5 liters of clean water.
remedies_catalog.dosage_schedule: Target the underside of tender shoots and buds where aphid colonies cluster.
remedies_catalog.best_timing: After 4:30 PM when direct sunlight has waned to avoid leaf scalding.
remedies_catalog.cultural_prevention: Encourage ladybird beetles and lacewings; spray strong water jet to dislodge early colonies.
remedies_catalog.seed_traits: Hardened cuticle leaves, highly resistant to viral leaf curl and aphid vectors.

language_translations.bn: ৫টি কাঁচা লঙ্কা ও ১টি রসুন থেঁতো করে জলে ২৪ ঘণ্টা রেখে ছেঁকে স্প্রে করুন। জাব পোকা দূরে পালাবে।
language_translations.hi: 5 हरी मिर्च और 1 लहसुन पीसकर 24 घंटे पानी में रखें, फिर छानकर छिड़काव करें। माहो कीट तुरंत नष्ट होंगे।

remedies_catalog.instructions: Mix 3-day-old sour buttermilk with 1 spoonful of wild turmeric powder. Drench soil to combat fungal spores naturally.
preparation_steps: Take 1 liter of 3-day-old sour desi cow buttermilk (sour curd whey).
Add 2 tablespoons (30 g) of freshly ground wild raw turmeric (curcumin).
Add 100 ml of fermented cow urine (optional indigenous booster) and dilute with 5 liters of water.
Stir clockwise with a wooden stick for 5 minutes to aerate lactic acid cultures.
remedies_catalog.dosage_schedule: Drench 250 ml of solution directly into the root zone soil of each infected plant.
remedies_catalog.best_timing: Morning when soil is warm, ensuring root uptake.
remedies_catalog.cultural_prevention: Improve field bed elevation by 10 cm; stop watering immediately until surface dries.
remedies_catalog.seed_traits: Natural anti-fungal root exudates, immune to seedling damping-off.

language_translations.bn: পুরনো টক ঘোলের সাথে এক চামচ কাঁচা হলুদ গুঁড়ো মিশিয়ে গাছের গোড়ার মাটিতে দিন। ছত্রাক ও শিকড় পচা বন্ধ হবে।
language_translations.hi: खट्टी छाछ में हल्दी मिलाकर जड़ों की मिट्टी में डालें। फंगस और जड़ गलन की समस्या दूर होगी।

remedies_catalog.condition: Yellow Stem Borer & Dead Heart / White Head
remedies_catalog.solution_title: Fermented Castor & Datura Bitter Leaf Decoction
remedies_catalog.instructions: Boil 100g datura, castor, and calotropis leaves in 2L cow urine. Dilute 1:10 with water and spray on tillers.
preparation_steps: Gather 100 g each of datura leaves, castor leaves, and neem leaves.
Boil gently in 2 liters of water until reduced by half.
Strain liquid and stir in 1 tablespoon of asafoetida powder.
Dilute 200 ml of concentrate in 10 liters of spray water.
remedies_catalog.dosage_schedule: Direct nozzle right down into the leaf sheath whorls and plant stems where larvae bore.
remedies_catalog.cultural_prevention: Clip top 2 inches of rice seedling leaves before transplanting to remove egg masses.
remedies_catalog.seed_traits: Dense silica-enriched outer culm prevents stem borer penetration.

language_translations.bn: ধুতুরা ও নিম পাতা সিদ্ধ করে হিং মিশিয়ে গাছের কান্ডের খাঁজে স্প্রে করুন। মাজরা পোকা বিনষ্ট হবে।
language_translations.hi: धतूरा और नीम के पत्तों का काढ़ा बनाकर हींग मिलाकर तने के पास छिड़कें। तना छेदक नष्ट होगा।

remedies_catalog.condition: Severe Heat Stress & Soil Compaction Desiccation
remedies_catalog.instructions: Lay 3-inch thick dry straw mulch infused with diluted cow dung slurry around crop rows to lock soil moisture.
preparation_steps: Chop waste banana pseudostem or dry paddy straw into 4-inch pieces.
Prepare a slurry of 2 kg cow dung in 15 liters of pond water.
Spread straw 8 cm deep along crop beds, then sprinkle slurry lightly on top.
The microbial crust seals moisture and lowers ground temperature by 4°C to 6°C.
remedies_catalog.dosage_schedule: Cover inter-row spaces uniformly. Retains moisture for 7-10 days without irrigation.
remedies_catalog.cultural_prevention: Intercrop with pigeon pea (arhar) to provide micro-shade and atmospheric nitrogen.
remedies_catalog.seed_traits: Waxier leaf surface prevents water evaporation during dry spells.

language_translations.bn: ধানের খড় ও গোবর জলের মালচিং দিয়ে মাটির আর্দ্রতা ধরে রাখুন। ৭ দিন পর্যন্ত সেচ ছাড়াই মাটি ঠান্ডা থাকবে।
language_translations.hi: पुआल और गोबर के घोल से मल्चिंग करें। धूप में भी मिट्टी में नमी 7 दिनों तक सुरक्षित रहेगी।

community_alerts.message: Sudden heatwave detected across Howrah basin! Mulch your soil with dry straw/banana leaves today to lock in moisture.
Neighboring cluster reported early aphid swarm. Inspect underside of leaves and prepare Neem spray.
